title: Cookies prompt always appears no matter what (may be mobile-only)
body:
**Describe the bug**
Title; watch the video attached below as well

**To Reproduce**
It appears on every page... it's possible that it's just on my end and unreproducable  
Firefox Daylight 33.0 (4119); iOS 14.5 Public Beta 7; iPhone 8  

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/745980892735864953/831527970061156372/video0.mp4

**Expected behavior**
It should only prompt once

**Additional context**
Not limited to index; happens both logged in and logged out; happens even if I manually review instead of just accepting all
